name: varia-sql-manager
description: An Electron and Monaco SQL Server management workbench backed by .NET.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run backend:build && electron-vite build
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/electron-smoke.mjs && node scripts/layout-smoke.mjs && node scripts/connections-smoke.mjs && node scripts/theme-smoke.mjs && node scripts/palette-smoke.mjs && node scripts/menus-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:electron: npm run check && npm run test:smoke
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && electron-vite build
